benefit: A full-season French marigold (Tagetes patula 'Single Gold' or 'Nemagold') cover the year before cucurbits suppresses Meloidogyne nematode populations by 60 to 90 percent. Most effective when marigold canopy closes within 8 weeks of seeding.

members.title: Marigold cover crop the season before cucurbit block
members.body: Direct-sow Tagetes patula at 1 to 2 lb per acre in late spring. Allow full canopy through summer. Mow and incorporate before frost. Plant cucurbits the following spring.
